name: Colnago
verdict: Colnago has been majority-owned by the Abu Dhabi fund Chimera Investments since May 2020.
note: Italian bicycle manufacturer; bike sponsor of UAE Team Emirates XRG (its clover is on the shorts and the jersey shoulders of the 2026 kit). Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Bloomberg calls Chimera part of a business empire overseen by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, who is Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi (claim g42-board-abu-dhabi-officials); whether a company he controls privately is a state link is the maintainer's call (the G42 review of 2026-09-27 treated Royal Group as private). Chimera's own owner isn't named by a checked source. No human-rights finding against Colnago found. The UAE's record is on main (uae-mass-trial-2024, mubadala-uae-convictions-upheld).
